rationale: A cross-captioner rotation pool. Positions 0 and 1 are indices 0/1 of the existing c2p0 013 stacked overlay (Qwen slot0 / slot1); position 2 is the Music Flamingo dedup corpus, its own single-caption overlay. All three carry text encoder fingerprint 27e88fac68d94a8a10e44d2db930a8f79db8ca0454ce996b82e448c48c40ab4c and cover the same 251,599 rows of the c2p0 cache list in the same order, so the pool is assembled at load time and no overlay is re-encoded.
